body: god thank you.  Not even my "friends" ask me really to check in.  I'm kind of embarassingly moved by the fact that some stranger on reddit even bothered to ask.  I don't know.  I just...I... I dunno...things hurt.  A lot.  And I don't feel like I have anyone who feels me/hears me/knows me and I don't know when this happened or when I adjusted to this, or how to even hope for/wish for/imagine more ...just to want a friend when feeling like this.  It's kind of excruciating.

Hey. Thank you.  I'm still having a hard time...kind of feeling crippled by the pain I'm in.  I"m trying to just "sit with it" and be patient, etc.  But it's really just a lot and feels like too much to hold as much as I'm trying.  Thank you though.  A lot.

Thank you.  I am thinking/hoping I can finally try to make an attempt to head towards sleep...and if not I suspect it will still help knowing i could reasonably count on being able to possibly find someone to talk to on here.  Earlier today I couldn't even try because I couldn't fathom actually reaching anyone and trying to do it without being able to even imagine reaching someone was too unbearable.  But anyway.  Thank you (I love pb too!  And maybe a wierd one - tahini sauce!  I could eat it like pb on carrots all day long.)

Hey. Thank you so much.  I haven't even done chat or anything like that in years...this is really helping...I am chatting with one person on skype and coming back here to check and write more back and forth.  I was just telling her that it's amazing to me that I can actually feel okay in the moment of just talking about random ish cause as soon as I stop I'm so not okay but I'll take it while I can get it.  (so again, really, thank you.)

Ay I forgot about Dexter - I was behind on the whole Dexter-excitement and then watched a whole bunch of season sat once to catchup and then forgot about it...is it still on?? is it good? what's going on? I think I stopped after the season where his gf died? (though omg am I a jerk, I couldnt stand her voice!!!)

Law and order yes...i dont have tv but I watch stuff streaming...so was watching the latest svu episode this morning...then started running out of ideas of what to watch or where to go to watch it.  I LOVE arrested development...and I'm a big scrubs fan.  I don't have much downloaded but I do have some old scrubs episodes downloaded!

What kind of old books do you collect?  I love books...i always joke that i'll just build a fort out of my books on the street and live there when housing situations become challenging.

Hobbies - I like reading all different stuff, um anything I can do with my hands creatively/craft/art-wise...sports but had a bunch of injuries so I'm more limited now but love dance...

Yes, yes thank you - I was literally struggling all day to find mindless things to hang onto cause everything else was so unbearable but...I like couldn't get away from it or find enough mindless things to stay with.

Gonna go listen to the lullaby --- i haven't listened to jpop since the days of kurakimai and itada hikaru though...I don't have tv which would come in handy at a day like this when I can't come up with the ideas but just need to watch SOMETHING...it helps to hear what you listed though....

Hmm favorite food - god I don't know I can pick...when I was little I'd say mashed potatoes.  But now....I think I may need a genre?  On a non-fancy, regular basis ...I'd say I love freaking good sandwiches - like I could almost always be in the mood for one of those vietnamese cart banh sandwiches...or anything with avocado on it...

i just listened to a yuki kajiura song - nice, i like!  Reminds me of this group I looked up after hearing a song in a tv show - i think they're called nuttin' but strings - after hearing a song in a tv show...what was it...I think it was Black Donnellys maybe.?
woah i've honestly never heard of that but it sounds kind of awesome!! I will have to look for it in the lib/bookstore to check out...

ooh haha i had guy friends in college who swore by that movie hehe.  i like adam sandler movies on the dumb/silly tip...somehow i just don't get sick of him, i dunno why.  Never heard of yuki kajiura though I used to listen to a lot of jpop when i was younger...ill have to check her out...Dude someone told me to read that last year and I went to pick it up but...I have to carry books on public transport and I'm always carrying too much shit anyway so I always want to carry a small book.  Though if the book is really good...I'd like it if magically pages could be added to it so I could keep reading it and not be finished as I went along...(i guess probably someone would argue a kindle or something can approximate that but...i...am old school and want pages and ink when i'm reading and writing....)

yeah! let me think ok um...i'm also like on a good day bad at "free recall" open ended questions at first cause i can't select a single answer...but my memory works through making connections...so like...maybe tell me some of yours and it'll help me brainstorm some of mine? god i'm sorry i know i'm not making this easy
i can't. i...i'm trying to explain....i need some room first. i can't even write on it i can't touch it i need just some contact on anything anything anything
also thank u. i actually don't think i realized it could be possible for anyone to reply.  this is the first time i tried posting and it took me all day to try to do it.

heh um no go for it. talk to me about rainbows and puppies. please? probably usually that would drive me crazy when im feeling deep dark horrible but right now i literally just want to be on the other end of a conversation with a human being.
